coverage.summary: Tenants evicted so the owner can remove the property from the rental housing market in Berkeley (Ellis Act withdrawal).

evidence.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.

result.notes: I kept the summary and supported it verbatim from D004. I removed other_conditions. D004 says the additional payment goes to 'qualifying households', but that limits who gets the extra payment amount; it does not describe which buildings, units or owners are covered. Its second clause ('not defined in the documents') is an auditor comment, not something a document says. The qualifying-household criteria remain unverified and belong in the requirement and review notes. I did not carry over coverage facts from D006 or D009 (pre-1980 buildings, partial or full coverage, exemptions such as the Golden Duplex). Those describe the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, and no document says they define the scope of the Ellis Implementation Ordinance. D001, D003, D005, D007, D008 and DX06 address other rules and say nothing about Ellis coverage.
